facts.fact: NAM-CSIRT, the national cyber security incident response team housed at CRAN, is stated to exist and operate: it issued a statement and second-quarter newsletter, with CRAN's CEO speaking for it.

NAM-CSIRT's Q2 2026 newsletter reports 513,921 cyber vulnerabilities and 161,547 cyber events detected in April-June 2026, up 39.8% and 56.7% on the previous quarter. (Reported by The Namibian, 2026-07-22.)
